notes.title: Patch #6 now available!
notes.content:
Hi there dear fans and virtual chiefs,

here we are again with a new patch to fix some of those nasty leftover bugs and to solve an important game blocker you were waiting for!

Here comes the complete changelog that shows you what issues we fixed:

-Roadblocks will not be saved.
 
-Pause screen / save menu issue.
 
-Dollar symbol is shown instead of euro.

-Normal textures start to pop up in strategic view.

-[Mission 27 + 28] Stretched mission icon.

-(Almost) no parking spots for the speed camera van in Districts 5 and 6.

-Different fill levels of the health bar for the same employee.

-Daily statistics can pop up during missions which can be annoying.

-Helicopter landing icon stays visible after going to the main menu and back or selecting another unit.

-Helicopter landing icon disappears after moving the mouse cursor off the map.

-When loading a savegame with a helicopter in-air the rotor blades do not spin.

And we also fixed one very annoying blocker you were waiting for:
-The max officer count does not increase by unlocking room upgrades!

Aren't these good news? :)

Once again we thank you for your feedback and all your support! Thanks folks!

notes.title: Patch #5 out now!
notes.content:
Dear Fans, 

we have good news for you - Patch #5 is out now and fixes several bugs.
Here you can find the complete changelog for this patch and which bugs were eliminated:

- Riot units often loose to rioters even if their level is much higher
- Missing info for units inside a car / selecting single units inside a car
- Roadblock sometimes still remains after being removed
- Patrol skill does not increase awareness circle
- Rookies (yellow) show as patrol officers (blue) when in cars
- Strategic map is too slow to navigate
- Numbered group 9 is not displayed
- Renaming vehicles and units should be possible
- Being able to skip the whole tutorial
- Feature: Entering/Leaving the strategic view by zooming out/zooming in
- Units returning to HQ should not have emergency lights on

Thank you everyone for your ongoing feedback and your support on finding some of those bugs! :D

notes.title: Patch #4 released just now!
notes.content:
Dear fans and virtual police chiefs,

we have wonderful news for you!
Our developers dug back into the code and eliminated several high priority bugs that we could find and that you reported to us.
Here you can find the change log for today's patch #4:

- Prison transporter doesn't carry away captured criminals sometimes.
- Instead of 60 seconds the timer for a mission is 60 minutes.
- [Mission 30] HQ upgrade needed which is already finished.
- [Mission 28] Saving and reloading breaks the save file
- Pedestrians remain standing on the streets and block the traffic/patrols
- Missions pop up in locked districts
- Patrol cars/bikes do not chase after fleeing suspects (pursuit)
- Search and neutralize suspect missions are too hard and not explained very well
- Roadblocks may do not stop pursuits
- Sometimes cars automatically move on their own or to the side of the map
- A criminal is inside the building and the officers can't arrest him
- Not able to purchase a vehicle in the tutorial
- Roadblock units sometimes won't react to criminals they discover

Thank you all again for your patience and for your help by reporting those bugs!

Your Police Tactics: IMPERIO Team

notes.title: Patch #3 just released!
notes.content:
Hey folks,

we are working hard on fixing those issues and were already able to eliminate the following major bugs with the newest patch:
[list]
[*][Mission 30] HQ upgrade needed which is actually already finished
[*]Instead of 60 seconds the timer for a mission is 60 minutes.
[*]Sometimes 3 Crimes take place at the same location at the same time.
[*]Now and then missions pop up in locked districts.
[/list]

Of course we'll keep on working down the list to get rid of the remaining issues. 
[list]
[*]"Search & Arrest missions" are to hard, respectively the area is too big.
[*]"Search and neutralize suspect missions" are too hard to complete and are not explained very well.
[*]Patrol cars/bikes do not chase after fleeing suspects (on pursuit).
[*]Pedestrians remain standing on the streets and block the traffic and/or patrols.
[*][Mission 30] HQ upgrade needed which is actually already finished

Thanks again for you patience!

notes.title: [Hotfix] Priority bugs fixed!
notes.content:
Good news everyone!

Thanks to your ongoing feedback and reportings we were able to detect the most important bugs that commonly occurred and already fixed them!
Here you can see which problems we solved so far:

- [MacOS] Saving the game spawns every previously solved issue on the map again
- Prison transporter doesn't carry away captured criminals
- [Quicksave mission 2] Storymission cannot be finished after loading the save
- Savegame does not load properly anymore
- Game crashes randomly sometimes
- Game sometimes randomly crashes during mission 2
- Mission 21 is not solvable since the crime scene display 0/0 criminals to arrest
- A non moving car is blocking the patrol path
- A police vehicle does not responds to the players commands

Of course that's not it. We will continue to gather your feedback and fix bugs to deliver you the best possible gaming experience!

Thanks again for your help!

Your Police Tactics: IMPERIO team
